summary: A student farewell speech is a minute or two of thanks to teachers, coaches and family and a push toward future goals.
realLife: High school seniors' goodbye speeches were short, thanked teachers, coaches and families, used light humor from shared school life, looked forward and left out sadness and classmates' names.
sources: NPR Generation Listen, speeches from high school seniors as they say goodbye to classmates (2019): https://www.nprillinois.org/generationlisten/2019-06-14/speeches-from-high-school-seniors-as-they-say-goodbye-to-classmates
inGame: a school record and a student's traits; needs: graduation or end-of-year scenes

turns.summary: The speaker names close friends and gets teary.
turns.writesBack: a tie to the named friends

turns.summary: The speaker uses humor and says little else.
turns.writesBack: a light mood; a memory of laughter
